title: Two teams, one Kubernetes cluster: how they don't collide
caption: Kubernetes Namespaces explained simply. How many namespaces does your team run?

scenes.vo: What happens when two engineers deploy an app with the exact same name? In Kubernetes, they collide into each other instantly.
scenes.heading: NAMESPACES

scenes.vo: Namespaces solve this cleanly. Think of your cluster as an apartment building, where every tenant gets their own private front door.
scenes.heading: APARTMENT WALLS

scenes.vo: Inside each namespace, names only need to be unique locally. Dev and Prod can both run an api on the same cluster.
scenes.heading: INSIDE NAMESPACES

scenes.vo: To isolate your workloads, target a specific room using the dash n flag, or set the namespace in your yaml manifests.
scenes.heading: THE TRICK

scenes.vo: So, Namespaces: virtual clusters, zero naming collisions, and clean team isolation. Follow for more Kubernetes made simple.
scenes.heading: NAMESPACES
